Name: Pierre's Shop (Editable)
Author: RavenWoodsDE
Description:
Requires Content Patcher and Stardew Valley v1.6

Optionally Python to run the script, but you can also manually edit the content.json instead.

[line]
In order for the script to do its job properly, take the following steps:

1. Open Itemlist.txt in any text editor of your choice.

2. Take a look at the lines; for each line, one item will be added to the shop.
The line format is: ItemID:Price or just ItemID (in which's case the price defaults to 500)
Check here for [url=https://mateusaquino.github.io/stardewids/]Item IDs[/url]

3. Edit the file to your liking, save.

4. Double Click "Run Script.bat - it will run python and the python script for you.

5. content.json should be updated now. Run the game to see if Pierre has your items <3
[line]
Hint 1: If running the script doesn't work, make sure Python is installed. Newest version will do.

Hint 2: You can also edit which shop is affected by the script and create a wide array of custom shop configurations easily! Just open the script in your text editor and change the line "SHOP_ID" to something else. 

Check here for the official [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Shops]Shop IDs[/url].
